test/mozilla/data/ecma/Date/15.9.5.8.js.comment: The shell adds US daylight saving time to the standard offset even in UTC. A mid-July clock keeps the monthly samples derived from TIME_NOW away from month boundaries.

test/mozilla/data/ecma/Date/15.9.5.14.js.comment: The shell computes expected local hours using US daylight saving rules. A July date keeps the sampled hours clear of transitions.

test/mozilla/data/ecma/Date/15.9.5.28-1..comment: The shell applies US daylight saving time when converting the overflowing minute value back to UTC.

test/mozilla/data/ecma/Date/15.9.5.29-1..comment: The shell applies US daylight saving time to the expected local time after the minutes overflow.

test/mozilla/data/ecma/Date/15.9.5.34-1..comment: Moving the July date to December 31 exercises the change from daylight to standard time in the shell's expected result.

test/mozilla/data/ecma/Date/15.9.5.35-1..comment: The shell applies US daylight saving time to the expected local time in June 1970.
